title: Trump Waives Russia Energy Tariffs, Sanctions in Graham Law - Bloomberg.com
description: President Donald Trump waived massive tariffs linked to Russian energy exports mandated in a law that he signed last month, as the measures complicated his push to lower diesel prices ahead of the US midterm elections.

title: Coastal homes burn as hot winds fuel California fires - NPR
description: High winds are fueling a fast-moving fire that has burned homes in Southern California. Flames engulfed expensive coastal properties and prompted thousands to evacuate.
